Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

The Children's Library will close temporarily for facility repairs.

We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

【Closure Period (All Day)】

December 4, 2025 (Friday) through January 15, 2026 (Friday)

【What You Need to Know】

• You cannot use the library for reading, borrowing books, or returning books during this period.

• If you reserved materials for pickup at the Children's Library, please pick them up at the Main Library (Shiritsu Toshokan) instead.

• The book drop box will remain available throughout the closure.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-lib.jp/calendar/post-85.html
